focus.name: interaction-spawn-upper-gated-family-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the four upper-route Type-0x20/0x1E/0x1F interaction handlers to stable creation and gate identities while retaining selector-qualified historical names.

contracts: Selector 0x12 directly enters LevelObjectSpawnEntry with the established upper Type-0x20 template.
Selector 0x64 creates the upper Type-0x1E actor only when 0x00FFF107 is nonzero; selector 0x63 creates the upper Type-0x1F actor only when 0x00FFF105 is nonzero.
Selector 0x10 directly creates the same Type-0x1F template without the selector-0x63 gate.
evidence: Exact 68000 handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Direct template loads, LevelObjectSpawnEntry calls, and selector-specific gate tests
limitations: The names identify exact upper-route templates and gate contracts, not user-facing scene roles.
The upstream lifecycle and dynamic reachability of the gate bytes remain unresolved.
